identify: Aphids are small, soft-bodied, pear-shaped green insects.
They appear in large numbers on young leaves or ears in cold and cloudy weather.
damage: Aphids suck the sap of the plant. They also spread virus diseases from plant to plant.

cultural: Plant tall border crops like maize, sorghum or millet to reduce the pest.
Grow barrier crops like mustard around the field.
biological: Protect ladybird beetles, lacewings, spiders and hover flies in the field.
